name: Maya captives sold to Cuba
traveler: Maya captives of the Caste War
summary: To be rid of prisoners and to raise money for the war, Yucatán's government ships Maya captives, men, women and children, to the sugar plantations of Cuba under ten-year 'labour contracts' that were sales in all but name. The trade runs until Benito Juárez bans it in 1861.

stops.note: Where the Caste War began in 1847.
Yucatán's port; the captives are shipped from the coast.

informs.note: Maya captives of the Caste War are sold to Cuba
